title: WebCart - Data API
description: Represents an online shopping cart for a store built with B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce, with total amounts for products, shipping and handling, and taxes. This object is available in API version 49.0 and later.

AccountId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
AccountId.description: ID of the account that owns this WebCart. In API version 51.0 and later, if the WebCart was created through Guest Browsing, this ID is the ID of the GuestBuyerProfile. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

BillingAddress.description: The mailing address to which this WebCart is billed.

BillingCity.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
BillingCity.description: The city of the billing address.

BillingCountry.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
BillingCountry.description: The country of the billing address.

BillingGeocodeAccuracy.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
BillingGeocodeAccuracy.description: The accuracy rating of the geocode for the billing address. Possible values are: Address Block City County ExtendedZip NearAddress Neighborhood State Street Unknown Zip

BillingLatitude.description: The latitude of the geocode for the billing address.

BillingLongitude.description: The longitude of the geocode for the billing address.

BillingPostalCode.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
BillingPostalCode.description: The postal code for the billing address.

BillingState.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
BillingState.description: The state of the billing address.

BillingStreet.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
BillingStreet.description: The street of the billing address. Enter up to 255 characters.

CurrencyIsoCode.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
CurrencyIsoCode.description: The ISO code for the currency that’s specified on the buyer’s account. Default value is USD. Possible values are: EUR—Euro USD—U.S. Dollar Note: Although this field is Nillable, if you want to use Commerce Webstore Cart Promotions with multi-currency enabled, this field is required.

GrandTotalAmount.description: Sum of all cart items’ TotalAmount, or WebCart TotalAmount plus WebCart TotalTaxAmount. This value includes all taxes and adjustments.

GuestCompanyName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
GuestCompanyName.description: Company name associated with a delivery for a guest customer. This field is available in API version 59.0 and later.

GuestEmailAddress.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
GuestEmailAddress.description: The email address of a guest buyer. This field is available in API version 52.0 and later.

GuestFirstName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
GuestFirstName.description: The first name of a guest buyer. This field is available in API version 52.0 and later.

GuestLastName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
GuestLastName.description: The last name (or surname) of a guest buyer. This field is available in API version 52.0 and later.

GuestPhoneNumber.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
GuestPhoneNumber.description: The phone number of a guest buyer. This field is available in API version 52.0 and later.

GuestSecondName.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
GuestSecondName.description: The second name of a guest buyer. This field is available in API version 52.0 and later.

InitialOrderReferenceNumber.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
InitialOrderReferenceNumber.description: A unique identifier assigned to the WebCart at the beginning of the checkout process. Initially populated when the checkout process is initiated, the InitialOrderReferenceNumber is then associated with the order created when the checkout is complete. This field is available in API version 61.0 and later.

InventoryReservationIdentifier.description: Reserved for future use. This field is available in API version 57.0 and later.

IsRepricingNeeded.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsRepricingNeeded.description: Whether the cart has changed since the last repricing. The default value is false.

IsSecondary.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsSecondary.description: Whether the cart is a secondary cart or a primary cart. This field is available in API version 52.0 and later.

LastRepricingDate.description: Date when the last repricing was done.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The name of this WebCart record. Name can be up to 255 characters.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: The ID of the owner of this WebCart. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

PaymentGroupId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PaymentGroupId.description: The ID of the WebCart payment group. This field is a relationship field.

PaymentMethodId.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PaymentMethodId.description: The method of payment for this WebCart. This field is a polymorphic relationship field.

PoNumber.properties: Create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort, Update
PoNumber.description: The purchase order number. Enter up to 80 characters.

Status.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Status.description: The status of this WebCart. Possible values are: Active—Cart is created and available for modifications, like adding or removing products or promotions. Checkout—Cart is in checkout. If the customer modifies the cart, the current checkout session is canceled. Closed—Checkout is complete and an order was created. The cart cannot be modified. PendingClosed—Cart is marked to be closed, but the request isn't completed yet. The cart can’t be modified. This value is available in API version 57.0 and later. PendingDelete—Cart is marked for delete, but the request isn't completed yet. The cart can’t be modified. Processing—Cart is processing. For example, taxes are being calculated. The cart can’t be modified.

TaxLocaleType.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
TaxLocaleType.description: The type of tax locale. Possible values are: Net Gross This field is available in API versions 52.0 to 54.0.

TaxType.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
TaxType.description: The type of tax policy. Possible values are: Automatic Net Gross This field is available in API version 55.0 and later.

TotalAdjustmentAmount.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Nillable, Sort
TotalAdjustmentAmount.description: A calculated field that reflects the total of all adjustments to the cart subtotal. Adjustments include item, tier, and cart level discounts.

TotalAmount.description: The sum of all cart items’ TotalPrice, or TotalProductAmount plus TotalChargeAmount. If the store tax type is Gross, the sum includes taxes. Note: Although this field is Nillable, if you want to use Commerce Webstore Cart Promotions, this field is required and must have a value greater than or equal to zero (0).

TotalAmountAfterAllAdjustments.description: The sum of all cart items after all price adjustments are applied. Adjustments include various types of discounts. This field is available in API version 52.0 and later.

TotalCartLevelAdjAmount.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Nillable, Sort
TotalCartLevelAdjAmount.description: Total cart level discount amount for the cart. This field is available in API version 61.0 and later.

TotalChargeAmount.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Nillable, Sort
TotalChargeAmount.description: The sum of all cart items’ TotalPrice for cart items of the type Charge.

TotalChargeTaxAmount.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Nillable, Sort
TotalChargeTaxAmount.description: The sum of all the cart items’ TotalTaxAmount for cart items of the type Charge.

TotalLineItemsWithErrors.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort
TotalLineItemsWithErrors.description: A calculated field that shows the total number of cart line items of type Product with errors. This field is available in API version 50.0 and later.

TotalListAmount.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Nillable, Sort
TotalListAmount.description: Sum of all the cart items’ TotalListPrice.

TotalProductAmount.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Nillable, Sort
TotalProductAmount.description: The sum of all the cart items’ TotalPrice for cart items of the type Product.

TotalProductCount.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Nillable, Sort
TotalProductCount.description: A count of all the products in the WebCart.

TotalProductItemAdjAmount.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Nillable, Sort
TotalProductItemAdjAmount.description: Total item level discount amount for the cart. This field is available in API version 61.0 and later.

TotalProductLineItemCount.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort
TotalProductLineItemCount.description: A calculated field that shows the total number of cart line items of type Product. This field is available in API version 60.0 and later.

TotalProductListAmount.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Nillable, Sort
TotalProductListAmount.description: The sum of all the cart items’ TotalListAmount for the CartItem type Product. This field is available in API version 59.0 and later.

TotalProductTaxAmount.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Nillable, Sort
TotalProductTaxAmount.description: The sum of all the cart items’ TotalTaxAmount for the CartItem type Product.

TotalPromoAdjustmentAmount.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Nillable, Sort
TotalPromoAdjustmentAmount.description: The total of all item discounts related to product promotions. This field is available in API version 52.0 and later.

TotalPromoAdjustmentTaxAmount.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Nillable, Sort
TotalPromoAdjustmentTaxAmount.description: The total tax adjustment for all item discounts related to product promotions. This field is available in API version 52.0 and later.

TotalTaxAmount.description: The sum of all cart items’ TotalTaxAmount, or TotalProductTaxAmount plus TotalDeliveryTaxAmount.

Type.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Restricted picklist, Sort, Update
Type.description: The WebCart type. Default value is Cart. Possible values are: Cart PayNowReadOnly ReadOnly Template

UniqueProductCount.properties: Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Nillable, Sort
UniqueProductCount.description: The count of unique product SKUs in the WebCart.

WebStoreId.description: The store ID related to this WebCart. This field is a relationship field.

special_access_rules: The WebCart object is available only if the B2B Commerce or D2C Commerce license is enabled.
associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless it’s noted, associated objects are available in the same API version as this object.

- **WebCartChangeEvent (API version 58.0)**: Change events are available for the object.
- **WebCartHistory**: History is available for tracked fields of the object.
- **WebCartOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **WebCartShare**: Sharing is available for the object.

TotalAdjustmentAmount.field_label: Total Quantity Based and Promotional Adjustment Amount in Cart

TotalCartLevelAdjAmount.field_label: Total cart level adjustment amount for all the items in the cart. Includes discount and surcharge.

TotalChargeItemAdjAmount.field_label: Total adjustment amount on a cart item of type charge. Includes discount and surcharge.

TotalChargeTaxAmount.field_label: Total Charge Tax Amount in Cart

TotalProductItemAdjAmount.field_label: Total adjustment amount on a cart item. Includes discount and surcharge.

TotalProductListAmount.field_label: Total Product List Amount in Cart

TotalProductTaxAmount.field_label: Total Product Tax Amount in Cart
